title: SB 2711 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to evidence of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec.1, amends TCA 2-7-112(c)(2)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) Sec.2, adds 2-7-112(c)(8)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec.3: secretary of state study of student ID cards for voting, done within existing resources; first report Jan 31, 2023, second report on use of (c)(8) Jan 31, 2024; subsection repealed Feb 1, 2024.
(other) Sec.4: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 2503308: carries slot a (student photo ID as (c)(8); item (2) restated).
(other) note: Companion HB 2813. Last action 2022-03-23: assigned to the General Subcommittee of Senate State and Local Government; no vote on record. Same text as SB 947 (2021) but with later report dates and a 'within existing resources' line.
